bank_book.rationale: Reuse the finite Batch 16 bank P/B band while regulatory capital, sustainable ROE and common-equity cost remain under review; not residual income.

layered_book.rationale: Reuse the finite Batch 17 layered-holding P/B band on the reviewed parent-common basis where available; not appraised NAV or completed SOTP.

operating_book.rationale: Reuse the finite Batch 17 filing-review P/B band while services cash flows and leases lack a complete FCFF bridge.

source.label: PBC FY2025 and 1H2026 PSE financial summary, PHP thousands

normalization.formula: reported PHP44.74 BVPS; bank regulatory capital and sustainable ROE not inferred

PBC.route_reason: Bank common-equity economics require residual income; P/B is a separate finite screen.
PBC.intrinsic_blocker: Regulatory capital, loan losses, sustainable ROE, dividends and cost of equity are not reconciled.
PBC.source_warning: Bank assets and liabilities are not FCFF inputs; the P/B range is a low-reliability screen, not an approved residual-income model.

source.label: PTC FY2025 and 1H2026 PSE financial summary

normalization.formula: reported PHP23.22 BVPS; zero parent fields treated as unavailable attribution

PTC.intrinsic_blocker: Parent-equity and parent-income fields display zero, so common attribution, capital quality, sustainable ROE and cost of equity are unresolved.
PTC.source_warning: The PSE summary displays zero parent-equity and parent-income fields despite positive total equity and BVPS; those zero fields are not treated as economic facts.

source.label: BKR FY2025 and 1H2026 PSE financial summary

source.label: APC FY2025 and 1H2026 PSE financial summary

APC.metric_label: 1H2026 PSE-reported rounded book value per share

normalization.formula: reported PHP0.02 rounded BVPS; not a funded project NAV

APC.route_reason: Potential project and investment interests require attributable SOTP; P/B is only a preliminary screen.

APC.source_warning: PSE FY2025 and 1H2026 summaries show zero gross revenue, losses and EPS rounded to zero. The PHP0.02 BVPS is rounded and the stock page has more outstanding than listed shares; a tiny P/B result is not an operating valuation.

source.label: IPM FY2025 and 1H2026 PSE financial summary

IPM.metric_label: 1H2026 parent equity per outstanding ordinary common share

normalization.formula: PHP848,022,273 parent equity / 690,000,000 outstanding common shares; reported total BVPS PHP1.80 is not substituted

IPM.route_reason: Waste-management operations and ownership require attributable SOTP; parent book value is a separate screen.

IPM.source_warning: The PSE-reported PHP1.80 BVPS follows consolidated total equity; parent equity per common share is about PHP1.229. The screen uses the parent basis and does not assume minority equity belongs to common holders.

source.label: CTS FY2025 and 1H2026 PSE financial summary
